items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard Charlie Parker there and all kinds of people.

ctx.x: Where everybody was trying to help.

Yeah. Yeah, my brother and I grew up quite differently. I remember his group of friends… maybe I should call my therapist and ask what he remembers (laughs) or call my…. There was a great jazz club in Cleveland. I’ll think of the name a little later. I heard Charlie Parker there and all kinds of people.
